gloss: to press, to corner, to close in on

definitions.gloss: to press, to corner, to close in on
definitions.explanation: To approach someone aggressively to press for answers or demand something. Often implies intimidating or confrontational behavior.

examples.japanese: {記者|きしゃ}が{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}る
{彼女|かのじょ}は{責任者|せきにんしゃ}に{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: She confronted the person in charge.

examples.japanese: {説明|せつめい}を{求|もと}めて{市民|しみん}が{市長|しちょう}に{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: Citizens pressed the mayor for an explanation.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}). Takes に particle for the person being pressed: ～に{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}る.

CONJUGATION: Godan verb (ra-row): {詰|つ}め{寄|よ}らない, {詰|つ}め{寄|よ}ります, {詰|つ}め{寄|よ}って.

NUANCE: {詰|つ}め{寄|よ}る conveys aggressive or confrontational pressing. It often describes reporters surrounding someone, protesters confronting officials, or someone demanding answers in an intimidating manner.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～に{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}る (to press/confront someone)
- {説明|せつめい}を{求|もと}めて{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}る (to press for an explanation)
- {記者|きしゃ}が{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}る (reporters close in)
- {責任|せきにん}を{追及|ついきゅう}して{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}る (to press someone about responsibility)

RELATED WORDS:
- {問|と}い{詰|つ}める (to press for answers - more verbal)
- {迫|せま}る (to press, approach - more general)
- {追及|ついきゅう}する (to pursue, investigate)
